hook: Bar owners: 3 questions before *New Year's Eve*
title: NYE *paperwork* quiz

questions.q: Your liquor license was renewed once. Is it good forever?
questions.why: Liquor licenses renew on a schedule. Check the date on yours.

questions.q: You hired 3 extra bartenders for December. What do you check first?
questions.why: Many areas require server training cards, and they expire too.

questions.q: Running a NYE event out on the patio. Is your normal permit enough?
questions.why: Special events can need their own permits. Ask early.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.

cta.title: Midnight is for the countdown, not the paperwork.
cta.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
